rule Suspicious_PowerShell_CobaltStrike_Download {
    meta:
        description = "Detects PowerShell script downloading payloads from remote sources using WebClient"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "T1105, T1059.001"
        malware_family = "CobaltStrike"
    strings:
        $webclient = "New-Object Net.WebClient" nocase
        $download = "DownloadData" nocase
        $invoke = "Invoke-Expression" nocase
    condition:
        all of them
}
